title: Merge report (<key>.report.json)
description: What `merge` writes for one article: the status, the rules that failed, the justifications and the coverage proof, bound to the article, profile and ruleset by their stamps. The shape is unchanged since v0.4.0, and a v0.4.0 report validates. A new field is a schema change and a line in docs/report-contract.md. A reader compares `article_sha256`, `profile_sha256` and `ruleset_version` with the article on disk and `plainspoken profile --json <article>` before trusting `status`.

article.description: The article path exactly as it was given to `merge`: it can be relative to the directory merge ran in. Resolve it against the project root (docs/report-contract.md), never against the reader's own directory.

profile_sha256.description: The profile file plus its calibration-notes file.

article_sha256.description: The article's bytes as merged, bare hex.

status.description: INCOMPLETE: a file missing, stale or malformed, or a rule without a verdict (see problems and coverage.missing). FAIL: a BLOCK rule failed. UNRESOLVED: a WARN rule failed with no accepted justification. PASS: none of those.

blocks.description: Rules that failed at BLOCK, sorted.

warns.description: Rules that failed at WARN, justified or not, sorted.

unresolved.description: The warns no accepted justification resolves.

unused_justifications.description: Justified rules that didn't fail at WARN.

problems.description: Why the report is INCOMPLETE, one line each.

metrics.description: The lint's text metrics (words, ttr, mattr, burstiness, ...), all numbers.

rules.description: Rule id to that rule's merged verdict, one entry per rule the lint or a judge decided.

verdict.description: pending-judge: a lint+judge rule whose judge verdict never arrived (the report is INCOMPLETE).

judge_verdict.description: Judge entries: the judge's own call, before a lint BLOCK forces verdict to fail.

lint_block.description: Pending lint+judge entries: the lint found a BLOCK.

evidence.description: Judge entries: the evidence as the judge gave it.
